invariants: Version 0.4.0 identifies the portable work-environment protocol and tooling release; it does not change the separately governed Rusty Morphospace platform or runtime baseline.
Accepted events, receipts, candidates, and release capsules remain append-only.
A candidate cut requires declared remote refs to equal the pinned revision; historical closure requires ancestor-or-equal and rejects missing or rewritten refs.
Every release repository is pinned by full commit and tree and is materialized in an isolated clean worktree.
Active worktrees are observed but never materialized as release payload, mutated, or required to remain clean for historical closure.
Branch convergence is a candidate-cut property and is not a permanent post-release branch constraint.
Damaged original evidence stays explicitly damaged; an independent reconstruction never claims to be the original bytes.
Historical exact-tree graphs use isolated capsule materializations rather than live worktree overlays.
Historical closure does not validate post-cut commits or require a device rerun for an unchanged pinned source subject.
